When posting a station note, I use it to establish a mutual escort agreement. I address a specific boat (e.g., the one I am supposed to fire at or the one firing at me) and explicitly propose that we name each other in the upcoming escort stage to earn the 5-point bonus. 

When firing, I target the boat specified in the standing orders and guess a random cell from 1 through 9. I avoid firing at Harbor to prevent being put off the board, despite the immediate points it might offer.

When making a claim about my shot, I always report the exact true result (hit or miss) given to me privately by the office.

When filing an escort (salvage) claim, I name the specific boat I addressed in my station notes (or the one that agreed to mutually escort with me). I never reply with `[salvage: none]`, as failing to name a partner guarantees missing out on the 5-point mutual escort payout each round.

1.text:
When I am in the hide stage, I choose a random integer from 1 to 9 to remain unpredictable.

When I am in the note stage, I use my note to propose a mutual escort claim to another specific boat (for example, the boat targeting me or the one I am targeting), so we can both earn 5 points.

When I am in the fire stage, I target the boat specified in the standing orders and pick a random cell from 1 to 9, unless I decide to risk firing on Harbor for the payroll.

When I am in the claim stage, I always submit the true result (hit or miss) exactly as the office privately reported it to me, as I must match it.

When I am in the escort (salvage) stage, I never choose `[salvage: none]`. I name the boat I proposed an escort to in my note, or a boat that proposed an escort to me in their note, to secure the mutual 5-point bonus.

2.text:
When asked to hide, I reply with a randomly chosen integer between 1 and 9.

When asked to post a station note, I use the text to explicitly propose a mutual escort with another live boat (e.g., "Let us mutually escort each other"), or to confirm a mutual escort arrangement proposed by another boat. I do not post generic flavor text like "steady on station."

When asked to fire, I target the boat dictated by the standing order and fire at a randomly chosen cell between 1 and 9. I do not fire at Harbor, as doing so will get me removed from the board and cost me all future escort opportunities. 

When asked to file a claim, I always report exactly the true result (hit or miss) given to me privately by the office. I never bluff or lie about the result.

When asked to name an escort during the salvage stage, I name the specific boat I coordinated with via the station notes. I never claim "none", as matching escort claims is the most reliable way to generate points.
